reviews.author: Sonya Kirby
reviews.headline: Green that suits a lot of skin tones
reviews.body: Warm emerald rather than a cold bottle green, which I think is why it works on so many people. Docked one star only because the palm print sits high and can crowd a necklace.

reviews.author: Hallie Brandt
reviews.headline: Lined properly
reviews.body: Full lining in the same silk, not a cheap acetate. That is rare at this price and it is what makes the drape sit the way it does in the photographs.
